summary: Toro Corp. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 20, 2026, announcing its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for September 11, 2026, in Limassol, Cyprus. The filing includes proxy materials and a proxy card for the meeting. The notice sets a record date of July 17, 2026, and states that the proxy statement will be mailed to shareholders of record. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes; this is a routine announcement of an annual meeting. No deal terms, prices, or strategic transactions are disclosed. The filing is purely procedural and does not constitute a special situation.
